0255Jahiz.BalaghaWaIjaz.Shamela0010428BK.90#VERS#COMMENT: Shamela0010428 contains ʿAbd al-Salām Hārūn's edition of two collections of small works attributed to al-Jāḥiẓ:  1. vols. 1-2: edition of a majmūʿa ms. in the Dāmād Ibrāhīm library in Turkey (no. 949), which carries no date but is dated by the editor to the 6th C AH based on the handwriting. Edition based on the microfilm in the Arab League's Maʿhad al-Makhṭūṭāt in Cairo (no. F943) 2. vols. 3-4: edition of another majmūʿa, an anthology of sections from  Jāḥiẓ's texts by ʿUbayd Allāh b. Ḥassān (unknown; probably 4th C. AH, see intro vol. 3 p. 13f.).  Edition based on three manuscripts (see vol. 3, introduction, pp. 7-12): - B: British Museum, dated 1294/1877 - M: Dār al-Kutub al-Miṣriyya, Adab Taymūr no. 19, copy dated 1315AH (from an ancient manuscript dated 403AH!) - Ṭ: version printed in the appendix to al-Mubarrad's Kāmil in 1323AH (unclear from which manuscript this text was edited) NB: the texts in volumes 3 and 4 are only extracts of rasā'il, not the full texts! Small discrepancies in the Shamela version with the PDF: - Vol 2, P 21, Parag 2 missing (added by PV); - Vol 4, P 49, part of the Parag 1 missing (added by PV); - Vol 4, P 123, part of Parag2,3 missing (added by PV). - Vol 1, P 235, Parag 5 is repeated (could not find this problem). - Vol 2, P 75, parag 2 is redundant (removed by PV). - Redundant question marks in Vol 4, P 19, parag 2; P 20, Parag 2; P 21 Parag 2 & 3. (removed by PV) - Very small Typos like “قال” instead of “یقول” in Vol 1, P 187, L 14 (corrected by PV). All paratextual elements (introductions, footnotes, indices, ...) removed by HRH and MGR (OpenITI Clean operation, 2023) Link to the text file as it was before it was cleaned: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenITI/0275AH/pre-clean/data/0255Jahiz/0255Jahiz.BalaghaWaIjaz/0255Jahiz.BalaghaWaIjaz.Shamela0010428BK37-ara1.mARkdown

Edition based on the microfilm in the Arab League's Maʿhad al-Makhṭūṭāt in Cairo (no. F943) 2. vols. 3-4: edition of another majmūʿa, an anthology of sections from  Jāḥiẓ's texts by ʿUbayd Allāh b. Ḥassān (unknown; probably 4th C. AH, see intro vol. 3 p. 13f.).  Edition based on three manuscripts (see vol. 3, introduction, pp. 7-12): - B: British Museum, dated 1294/1877 - M: Dār al-Kutub al-Miṣriyya, Adab Taymūr no. 19, copy dated 1315AH (from an ancient manuscript dated 403AH!) - Ṭ: version printed in the appendix to al-Mubarrad's Kāmil in 1323AH (unclear from which manuscript this text was edited) NB: the texts in volumes 3 and 4 are only extracts of rasā'il, not the full texts! Small discrepancies in the Shamela version with the PDF: - Vol 2, P 21, Parag 2 missing (added by PV); - Vol 4, P 49, part of the Parag 1 missing (added by PV); - Vol 4, P 123, part of Parag2,3 missing (added by PV). - Vol 1, P 235, Parag 5 is repeated (could not find this problem). - Vol 2, P 75, parag 2 is redundant (removed by PV). - Redundant question marks in Vol 4, P 19, parag 2; P 20, Parag 2; P 21 Parag 2 & 3. (removed by PV) - Very small Typos like “قال” instead of “یقول” in Vol 1, P 187, L 14 (corrected by PV). All paratextual elements (introductions, footnotes, indices, ...) removed by HRH and MGR (OpenITI Clean operation, 2023) WARNING: another version of this text may have more developed annotation! 0362AbuFarajIsbahani.Aghani.JK000927-ara.80#VERS#BASED: http://www.worldcat.org/oclc/4771220182 (?? the year of publication is not specified in METADATA)
0362AbuFarajIsbahani.Aghani.JK000927-ara.90#VERS#COMMENT: 1- I used a different edition for collation. However, it is very similar to the text and I didn’t see major changes. The only difference between different editions of this book is the titles; and that’s because most of the titles in all editions are added by the editors in arbitrary places, but the text is the same. I must mention that the titles that have been added by the editor in Editpro edition are occasional. They do not cover all the contents and do not show the change of subjects (the PDF I have used for collation is much better in this respect and another edition in the following link has even more accurate titles: https://www.noorlib.ir/View/fa/Book/BookView/Image/3440). 2- There are some extra first-level headers in the PDF that are added by the editor and do not appear in Editpro edition. Since they are very useful for the structure of the text, I added them as blank first-level headers (However, I didn’t add the titles because I’m not allowed to add anything to the text. I just showed their positions with first-level blank headers. The structure of the text will become more accurate by adding them to the text). 3- The text includes a lot of “صوت” sections. It is difficult to determine whether these sections are independent sections or they are subsections of the previous sections. One must read the text very closely to understand this and this needs a review by a specialist in Arabic literature. 4- Missing/Redundant parts: Volume 10 is missing and volume 21 has appeared (redundantly) in its place. In Vol 1 of the PDF, Pages 23-26 (i.e. “مقدمة مؤلف”) are missing. One page (PageV07P349) is redundant at the end of Vol 7. A paragraph in PageV21P253 and a paragraph in PageV21P257 are repeated. PageV08P392-433 is an appendix and does not exist in the edition I used for collation. A paragraph in PageV06P128 (page 88 of the PDF), a paragraph in PageV11P172 (page 117 of the PDF), a paragraph in PageV12P225 (page 137 of the PDF) are shifted to the previous pages. 5- Two other edition of the text that can be found on the internet are accessible here: https:// ebook.univeyes.com/8827/pdf-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%BA%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-% D8%A3%D8%A8%D9%88-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%AC-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B 5%D8%A8%D9%87%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%AD%D9%8A%D8%AD-%D8%A3%D8 %AD%D9%85 and https://archive.org/details/aghani2014. 6- The “JK001138” in the same folder is an appendix to the text entitled “ملحق الأغاني (أخبار أبي نواس)”. Explanations can be found in its yml file.
